{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f'Number of missing age entries (customer_age = -1): {missing_age_count}')

# Inspect revenue column: check if it contains commas
print('\nFirst few revenue values (before parsing):')
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check if 'converted' is 1 only for completed orders
converted_not_completed = (df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] != 'completed')
print(f'Number of orders with converted=1 but status != completed: {converted_not_completed.sum()}')"}
